**Implements:** [`IAlBinding`](/reference/base-openal/ialbinding/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.backend.lwjgl2.binding` · **Module:** `backend-lwjgl2` · **Source:** [Lwjgl2AlBinding.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/backend/lwjgl2/src/main/java/dev/joid/backend/lwjgl2/binding/Lwjgl2AlBinding.java)<br/>

<a id="Lwjgl2AlBinding-method-createContext"></a>

### createContext

`void createContext()` 

**Throws:**

- `IllegalStateException`: LWJGL 2 cannot create the OpenAL context (…), check that an audio output device is connected and enabled

Creates the OpenAL context of LWJGL 2 with `AL.create()`.
Throws an `IllegalStateException` with the reason of LWJGL when no output device can be opened.
